services.title: Services
services.carousel: Services: swipe to see them all
services.intro: Six ways to work together, from the most demanding technical translation to the creative adaptation of your advertising.

items.title: Translation
items.summary: Technical, legal and tourism translation from English and German into Spanish.
body: Translation is the best way to carry knowledge from one country to another, and by translating your texts from English or German into Spanish you will reach a far wider audience. That is why at Tradissea we specialise in translation services for a range of industries, such as:
list: Technical translation (rail industry and industrial machinery)
bodyAfter: If you are looking for a professional translator for your documents, we can help you with technical manuals, technical specifications, product sheets, instruction manuals, brochures, restaurant menus, travel guides and much more.

items.title: Proofreading
items.summary: Revision, editing and proofreading of Spanish texts, down to the last comma.
body: It is always worth taking a second look so that not even a comma slips through. With our Spanish revision, editing and proofreading service, your publications will be flawless.

So what is the difference between revising and proofreading? While editing and proofreading could be considered synonyms, revision involves something more. When we proofread a text we look only at the final document, that is, the translation.
When we revise a text, we carry out a bilingual comparison that also takes the source document into account. If you would like an expert eye on your translations, do get in touch.

items.title: Post-editing
items.summary: The speed of machine translation with the reliability of a professional translator.
body: A professional translator handles an average of 2,000 words a day. So how can we help you with that 4,000-word manual you need by tomorrow morning? Post-editing.
Machine translation has been improving steadily for the past decade and, with our experience and the RWS post-editing certificate, the result will be top quality despite the deadline.

When the project allows it, we can make the most of the speed of machine translation without losing reliability, leaving the revision of the machine-translated text in the hands of a professional translator. This is how we check whether your project is suitable:
list: Analysis of the source material (documentation, audiovisual material, etc.) and possible pre-editing.
Selection of the most suitable engine and the type of post-editing (light or full).
bodyAfter: As soon as you tell us it works for you, we will start post-editing your documents.
Not sure what you need, or working with a tight budget? Tell us about the project and we will suggest the service that fits best.

items.title: Consulting
items.summary: Glossaries, style guides and multilingual project management with linguistic criteria.
body: Running a multilingual project means keeping many variables in mind. There is nothing better than the advice of a professional linguist to benefit from an expert opinion. For example, we could help you with:
list: Glossaries and translation memories (with the help of translation technology such as Trados Studio).
Style guides (so that every translation speaks with your brand's voice).
Linguistic analysis (target regional variety, syntax, spelling, specialised vocabulary, etc.).
bodyAfter: Whatever your situation, we will assess your case and put all our professionalism and technology at your service.

items.title: Localisation
items.summary: We adapt your website or eLearning course to the language, the culture and the country.
body: Have you ever seen a website translation that simply did not match reality? Localisation adapts your website or eLearning course not only to the target language, but also to the culture and the context of the country where you want to make your mark.
These adaptations may involve removing content that would not work in that country, or even changing images or videos.

For example, did you know that in the Spanish version of the film «Captain America: The Winter Soldier», a list of key events replaced the Moon landing with Chupa Chups lollipops? That is audiovisual localisation at work.

items.title: Transcreation
items.summary: The most creative side of translation: advertising that moves people just like the original.
body: The most creative side of translation, the one closest to marketing. If you want your advertising to move your target audience exactly as the original does, this is the service for you. Most international brands use this type of translation to adapt to each country.

With your target audience in mind, we will adapt your texts to their particular way of speaking. This matters enormously in languages with many varieties, such as Spanish, where the word «batacazo» can mean either a triumph or a disaster depending on where you are.
At Tradissea we focus on European Spanish, with translators who are native speakers of this variety.

about.heading: A story of Ithaca and journeys
about.lead: Cavafy took me to Ithaca and Ulysses whispered this name to me.
body: Translation is like an odyssey: you set off from the source text to reach the target text, and you have to overcome all kinds of obstacles to arrive without losing your head. At Tradissea you will find the services that best suit your project.

What is our goal? To reach your audience in their mother tongue. We want your message to go straight to the heart, and the best way to do that is to speak their language. At Tradissea we do not just translate: we get involved in your project as if it were our own so that everything fits.
At Tradissea we are communication experts: from the moment you present your project until it is finished, we make sure every requirement is met and we are always happy to answer any question.

We are a company with a particular eye for detail: whether it is specific terminology or a special format, we check that the translation matches the original down to the very last detail. We use the most advanced software tools to achieve the best results, adapting the style of the translation to the required format.
